---
title: "Import the GraphQL packages the adapter depends on"
description: "Drop when the pinned release's TanStack Start GraphQL handler imports @payloadcms/graphql and graphql-http with literal specifiers."
---

<!-- Generated by `pnpm upstream export` from the patch's commit message on top of Payload v4.0.0-beta.3. Edit the commit, not this page. -->

The GraphQL handler loads @payloadcms/graphql and graphql-http through
variables with /* @vite-ignore */, so no bundler sees them. That kept the
packages optional while sites installed them themselves. Since #18593 they
are dependencies of the adapter, but the hidden imports stayed. A Worker has
no node_modules to load them from at runtime, so the GraphQL route fails with
"No such module" unless the build rewrites the imports.

The handler now imports both with literal specifiers, as @payloadcms/next
does, and the tsconfig references ../graphql like next's.

- **Patch:** `tanstack-graphql-literal-imports`, committed as `fix(tanstack-start): import the GraphQL packages the adapter depends on`
- **Upstream:** Not proposed
- **Tests:** `pnpm --filter @payloadcms/tanstack-start build; e2e suite (tests/api.spec.ts GraphQL tests)`
- **Diff:** [`upstream/patches/0016-fix-tanstack-start-import-the-GraphQL-packages-the-a.patch`](https://github.com/AdiRishi/offload-cms/blob/main/upstream/patches/0016-fix-tanstack-start-import-the-GraphQL-packages-the-a.patch)
